name: SenseNova-SI-1.3 (Qwen3-VL-8B)
usage: Spatial questions on images (distances, layout, relative position), fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-8B

licence.note: no LICENSE file; base Qwen3-VL-8B is Apache 2.0

size_gb.note: safetensors; its only .py is an upload script

runtimes.value: Qwen3-VL architecture: mlx-vlm `qwen3_vl`, Transformers; community GGUF (mmproj not checked)

web.scope: Released 10.04.2026: last 6 months plus launch. Hacker News (no comment on this model), Hugging Face discussions (none), GitHub issues of OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-SI. Reddit not readable. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: No user report on this model; the card itself warns of overfitting and language shortcuts; general comments say vision-language models remain weak at spatial reasoning.
web.verdict: Spatially fine-tuned Qwen3-VL; untested by users

comments.text: General comments on vision-language models: "In general llms are weak with spatial reasoning. This seems to be an unsolved problem." ([HN, 02.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49928768)); "When put to the test in real-world environment, the capabilities don't look as impressive as benchmarks." ([HN, 04.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49953304)).

Users discuss reproducing the VSI-Bench numbers ([SenseNova-SI #15, 08.01.2026](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-SI/issues/15), launch period of an earlier version). The model card mentions overfitting and "language shortcuts".
